# A footnotes sample

This fixture exercises the notes pipeline in the shape pandoc produces from
a .docx: markers in the body, definitions at the end, a full citation first
and shortened repeats after, one Ibid., an organisation, and a bibliography
that already lists one of the cited works.

## Findings

Prompt injection was characterised at scale,[^1] and the agent-level
reformalisation followed.[^2] The authorization framework is tracked by the
IETF.[^3] The original characterisation is revisited later,[^4] and the point
is repeated with a page number.[^5] A bibliography entry nobody cites appears
below, and an orphan marker appears here.[^9]
